evidence.note: Wide lower drawer to the left of the range is fully closed.
User is pulling the drawer outward; its contents have become visible.
Drawer is clearly open and remains open during the following traversal.
User is pushing the still-open drawer inward.
Drawer is fully closed again.

events.object_description: Wide upper drawer in the white base cabinet to the left of the range

evidence.note: Both wooden doors of the upper cabinet above the cooktop are closed.
User grasps the left cabinet door.
Left door is open, exposing the left side of the cabinet.
Both cabinet doors are still open.
Left door has been closed while the right door remains open.

events.object_description: Left wooden door of the upper cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: Right door is still closed while the left cabinet door is open.
User manipulates the remaining cabinet door.
Right door is open; both sides of the cabinet are exposed.
Right door remains open after the left door has closed.
Right door is closed and the cabinet front is fully shut.

events.object_description: Right wooden door of the upper cabinet above the cooktop/range hood

evidence.note: Wide upper drawer in the white base cabinet to the right of the range is closed.
User grasps the drawer handle to pull it open.
Drawer is open, revealing foil boxes, utensils, and cloths.
Drawer remains clearly open.
User pushes the drawer shut; the front is nearly or fully flush.
Drawer is fully closed.

events.object_description: Wide upper utensil drawer in the white base cabinet to the right of the range

notes: Four distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two adjacent upper-cabinet doors are reported separately because they are manipulated sequentially and close sequentially.
scene_description: A first-person camera surveys a narrow kitchen, then the user opens and closes a left-side base drawer, separately opens and closes two upper-cabinet doors above the cooktop, and finally opens and closes a right-side utensil drawer.
